description: This file implements default time domain allocation for PUSCH in 5G NR, including functions to generate and retrieve resource allocation tables based on configuration parameters, following 3GPP TS38.214 specifications.

methods.name: s_and_len
methods.description: Helper function to construct ofdm_symbol_range with start and length.

methods.name: pusch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get_j
methods.description: Returns the value j for a given subcarrier spacing, based on TS38.214 Table 6.1.2.1.1-4.

methods.name: pusch_default_time_allocations_default_A_table
methods.description: Generates the default PUSCH time domain resource allocation tables for normal and extended cyclic prefix.

methods.name: pusch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific row from the default allocation table based on configuration.

methods.name: get_c_rnti_pusch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Returns the list of PUSCH time domain allocations based on search space and BWP configurations.
